text_en: The burden of Ninive. The book of the vision of Nahum, the Elcesite.
text_la: Onus Ninive. Liber visionis Nahum Elcesæi.
text_pt: Peso de Nínive. Livro da visão de Naum, o elcosita.
text_el: λῆμμα Νινευη βιβλίον ὁράσεως Ναουμ τοῦ Ελκεσαίου

text_en: The Lord is a jealous God , and a revenger: the Lord is a revenger, and has wrath : the Lord takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he is angry with his enemies.
text_la: Deus æmulator, et ulciscens Dominus : ulciscens Dominus, et habens furorem : ulciscens Dominus in hostes suos, et irascens ipse inimicis suis.
text_pt: O Senhor é Deus zeloso e vingador; o Senhor é vingador e cheio de furor; o Senhor toma vingança contra os seus adversários, e guarda a ira contra os seus inimigos.
text_el: θεὸς ζηλωτὴς καὶ ἐκδικῶν κύριος ἐκδικῶν κύριος μετὰ θυμοῦ ἐκδικῶν κύριος τοὺς ὑπεναντίους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξαίρων αὐτὸς τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord is patient, and great in power, and will not cleanse and acquit the guilty. The Lord's ways are in a tempest, and a whirlwind, and clouds are the dust of his feet.
text_la: Dominus patiens, et magnus fortitudine, et mundans non faciet innocentem. Dominus in tempestate et turbine viæ ejus, et nebulæ pulvis pedum ejus.
text_pt: O Senhor é tardio em irar-se, mas grande em poder, e ao culpado não tem por inocente; o Senhor tem o seu caminho na tormenta e na tempestade, e as nuvens são o pó dos seus pés.
text_el: κύριος μακρόθυμος καὶ μεγάλη ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀθῳῶν οὐκ ἀθῳώσει κύριος ἐν συντελείᾳ καὶ ἐν συσσεισμῷ ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ νεφέλαι κονιορτὸς ποδῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: He rebukes the sea and dries it up: and brings all the rivers to be a desert . Basan languishes and Carmel : and the flower of Libanus fades away.
text_la: Increpans mare, et exsiccans illud, et omnia flumina ad desertum deducens. Infirmatus est Basan et Carmelus, et flos Libani elanguit.
text_pt: Ele repreende ao mar, e o faz secar, e esgota todos os rios; desfalecem Basã e o Carmelo, e a flor do Líbano murcha.
text_el: ἀπειλῶν θαλάσσῃ καὶ ξηραίνων αὐτὴν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ποταμοὺς ἐξερημῶν ὠλιγώθη ἡ Βασανῖτις καὶ ὁ Κάρμηλος καὶ τὰ ἐξανθοῦντα τοῦ Λιβάνου ἐξέλιπεν

text_en: The mountains tremble at him, and the hills are made desolate: and the earth has quaked at his presence, and the world, and all that dwell therein.
text_la: Montes commoti sunt ab eo, et colles desolati sunt : et contremuit terra a facie ejus, et orbis, et omnes habitantes in eo.
text_pt: Os montes tremem perante ele, e os outeiros se derretem; e a terra se levanta na sua presença; e o mundo, e todos os que nele habitam.
text_el: τὰ ὄρη ἐσείσθησαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ βουνοὶ ἐσαλεύθησαν καὶ ἀνεστάλη ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἡ σύμπασα καὶ πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Who can stand before the face of his indignation? And who shall resist in the fierceness of his anger ? His indignation is poured out like fire: and the rocks are melted by him.
text_la: Ante faciem indignationis ejus quis stabit? et quis resistet in ira furoris ejus? Indignatio ejus effusa est ut ignis, et petræ dissolutæ sunt ab eo.
text_pt: Quem parará diante do seu furor, e quem persistirá diante do ardor da sua ira? A sua cólera se derramou como um fogo, e as rochas foram por ele derrubadas.
text_el: ἀπὸ προσώπου ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ τίς ὑποστήσεται καὶ τίς ἀντιστήσεται ἐν ὀργῇ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ ὁ θυμὸς αὐτοῦ τήκει ἀρχάς καὶ αἱ πέτραι διεθρύβησαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: The Lord is good , and gives strength in the day of trouble: and knows them that hope in him.
text_la: Bonus Dominus, et confortans in die tribulationis, et sciens sperantes in se.
text_pt: O Senhor é bom, ele serve de fortaleza no dia da angústia, e conhece os que confiam nele.
text_el: χρηστὸς κύριος τοῖς ὑπομένουσιν αὐτὸν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως καὶ γινώσκων τοὺς εὐλαβουμένους αὐτόν

text_en: But with a flood that passes by, he will make an utter end of the place thereof: and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
text_la: Et in diluvio prætereunte consummationem faciet loci ejus, et inimicos ejus persequentur tenebræ.
text_pt: E com uma inundação trasbordante acabará de uma vez com o seu lugar; e as trevas perseguirão os seus inimigos.
text_el: καὶ ἐν κατακλυσμῷ πορείας συντέλειαν ποιήσεται τοὺς ἐπεγειρομένους καὶ τοὺς ἐχθροὺς αὐτοῦ διώξεται σκότος

text_en: What do you devise against the Lord ? He will make an utter end: there shall not rise a double affliction.
text_la: Quid cogitatis contra Dominum? Consummationem ipse faciet : non consurget duplex tribulatio,
text_pt: Que pensais vós contra o Senhor? Ele mesmo vos consumirá de todo; não se levantará por duas vezes a angústia.
text_el: τί λογίζεσθε ἐπὶ τὸν κύριον συντέλειαν αὐτὸς ποιήσεται οὐκ ἐκδικήσει δὶς ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἐν θλίψει

text_en: For as thorns embrace one another: so while they are feasting and drinking together, they shall be consumed as stubble that is fully dry.
text_la: quia sicut spinæ se invicem complectuntur, sic convivium eorum pariter potantium; consumentur quasi stipula ariditate plena.
text_pt: Porque ainda que eles se entrelacem como os espinhos, e se saturem de vinho como bêbados, serão inteiramente consumidos como palha seca.
text_el: ὅτι ἕως θεμελίου αὐτῶν χερσωθήσεται καὶ ὡς σμῖλαξ περιπλεκομένη βρωθήσεται καὶ ὡς καλάμη ξηρασίας μεστή

text_en: Out of you shall come forth one that imagines evil against the Lord , contriving treachery in his mind.
text_la: Ex te exibit cogitans contra Dominum malitiam, mente pertractans prævaricationem.
text_pt: De ti saiu um que maquinou o mal contra o Senhor, um conselheiro vil.
text_el: ἐκ σοῦ ἐξελεύσεται λογισμὸς κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου πονηρὰ λογιζόμενος ἐναντία

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Though they were perfect: and many of them so, yet thus shall they be cut off, and he shall pass: I have afflicted you, and I will afflict you no more.
text_la: Hæc dicit Dominus : Si perfecti fuerint, et ita plures, sic quoque attondentur, et pertransibit : afflixi te, et non affligam te ultra.
text_pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Por mais seguros que estejam, e por mais numerosos que sejam, ainda assim serão exterminados, e ele passará; eu te afligi, mas não te afligirei mais.
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος κατάρχων ὑδάτων πολλῶν καὶ οὕτως διασταλήσονται καὶ ἡ ἀκοή σου οὐκ ἐνακουσθήσεται ἔτι

text_en: And now I will break in pieces his rod with which he struck your back, and I will burst your bonds asunder.
text_la: Et nunc conteram virgam ejus de dorso tuo, et vincula tua disrumpam.
text_pt: Mas agora quebrarei o seu jugo de sobre ti, e romperei os teus laços.
text_el: καὶ νῦν συντρίψω τὴν ῥάβδον αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ τοὺς δεσμούς σου διαρρήξω

text_en: And the Lord will give a commandment concerning you, that no more of your name shall be sown: I will destroy the graven and molten thing out of the house of your God , I will make it your grave, for you are disgraced.
text_la: Et præcipiet super te Dominus; non seminabitur ex nomine tuo amplius : de domo Dei tui interficiam sculptile, et conflatile; ponam sepulchrum tuum, quia inhonoratus es.
text_pt: Contra ti, porém, o Senhor deu ordem que não haja mais linhagem do teu nome; da casa dos teus deuses exterminarei as imagens de escultura e de fundição; ali farei o teu sepulcro, porque és vil.
text_el: καὶ ἐντελεῖται ὑπὲρ σοῦ κύριος οὐ σπαρήσεται ἐκ τοῦ ὀνόματός σου ἔτι ἐξ οἴκου θεοῦ σου ἐξολεθρεύσω τὰ γλυπτὰ καὶ χωνευτά θήσομαι ταφήν σου ὅτι ταχεῖς

text_en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that brings good tidings, and that preaches peace: O Juda , keep your festivals, and pay your vows : for Belial shall no more pass through you again, he is utterly cut off.
text_la: Ecce super montes pedes evangelizantis, et annuntiantis pacem. Celebra, Juda, festivitates tuas, et redde vota tua, quia non adjiciet ultra ut pertranseat in te Belial : universus interiit.
text_pt: O destruidor subiu contra ti. Guarda tu a fortaleza, vigia o caminho, fortalece os lombos, reforça muito o teu poder.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη οἱ πόδες εὐαγγελιζομένου καὶ ἀπαγγέλλοντος εἰρήνην ἑόρταζε Ιουδα τὰς ἑορτάς σου ἀπόδος τὰς εὐχάς σου διότι οὐ μὴ προσθήσωσιν ἔτι τοῦ διελθεῖν διὰ σοῦ εἰς παλαίωσιν συντετέλεσται ἐξῆρται

text_en: He has come up that shall destroy before your face, that shall keep the siege: watch the way, fortify your loins, strengthen your power exceedingly.
text_la: Ascendit qui dispergat coram te, qui custodiat obsidionem : contemplare viam, conforta lumbos, robora virtutem valde.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor restaurará a excelência de Jacó como a excelência de Israel; porque os saqueadores os despojaram, e destruíram os seus sarmentos.
text_el: ἀνέβη ἐμφυσῶν εἰς πρόσωπόν σου ἐξαιρούμενος ἐκ θλίψεως σκόπευσον ὁδόν κράτησον ὀσφύος ἄνδρισαι τῇ ἰσχύι σφόδρα

text_en: For the Lord has rendered the pride of Jacob , as the pride of Israel : because the spoilers have laid them waste, and have marred their vine branches.
text_la: Quia reddidit Dominus superbiam Jacob, sicut superbiam Israël; quia vastatores dissipaverunt eos, et propagines eorum corruperunt.
text_pt: Os escudos dos seus fortes serão vermelhos, os homens valorosos estarão vestidos de escarlate, os carros como tochas flamejantes no dia da sua preparação, e os ciprestes serão terrivelmente abalados.
text_el: διότι ἀπέστρεψεν κύριος τὴν ὕβριν Ιακωβ καθὼς ὕβριν τοῦ Ισραηλ διότι ἐκτινάσσοντες ἐξετίναξαν αὐτοὺς καὶ τὰ κλήματα αὐτῶν διέφθειραν

text_en: The shield of his mighty men is like fire, the men of the army are clad in scarlet, the reins of the chariot are flaming in the day of his preparation, and the drivers are stupefied.
text_la: Clypeus fortium ejus ignitus, viri exercitus in coccineis; igneæ habenæ currus in die præparationis ejus, et agitatores consopiti sunt.
text_pt: Os carros correrão furiosamente nas ruas, colidirão um contra o outro nos largos caminhos; o seu aspecto será como o de tochas, correrão como relâmpagos.
text_el: ὅπλα δυναστείας αὐτῶν ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἄνδρας δυνατοὺς ἐμπαίζοντας ἐν πυρί αἱ ἡνίαι τῶν ἁρμάτων αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἑτοιμασίας αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἱππεῖς θορυβηθήσονται

text_en: They are in confusion in the ways, the chariots jostle one against another in the streets: their looks are like torches, like lightning running to and fro.
text_la: In itineribus conturbati sunt; quadrigæ collisæ sunt in plateis : aspectus eorum quasi lampades, quasi fulgura discurrentia.
text_pt: Ele se lembrará dos seus valentes; eles, porém, tropeçarão na sua marcha; apressar-se-ão para chegar ao seu muro, quando o amparo for preparado.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς καὶ συγχυθήσονται τὰ ἅρματα καὶ συμπλακήσονται ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἡ ὅρασις αὐτῶν ὡς λαμπάδες πυρὸς καὶ ὡς ἀστραπαὶ διατρέχουσαι

text_en: He will muster up his valiant men , they shall stumble in their march: they shall quickly get upon the walls thereof: and a covering shall be prepared.
text_la: Recordabitur fortium suorum; ruent in itineribus suis : velociter ascendent muros ejus, et præparabitur umbraculum.
text_pt: As portas dos rios se abrirão, e o palácio será dissolvido.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσονται οἱ μεγιστᾶνες αὐτῶν καὶ φεύξονται ἡμέρας καὶ ἀσθενήσουσιν ἐν τῇ πορείᾳ αὐτῶν καὶ σπεύσουσιν ἐπὶ τὰ τείχη καὶ ἑτοιμάσουσιν τὰς προφυλακὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the temple is thrown down to the ground.
text_la: Portæ fluviorum apertæ sunt, et templum ad solum dirutum.
text_pt: É decretado: ela será levada cativa, conduzida para cima; e as suas servas a acompanharão, gemendo como pombas, batendo em seus peitos.
text_el: πύλαι τῶν ποταμῶν διηνοίχθησαν καὶ τὰ βασίλεια διέπεσεν

text_en: And the soldier is led away captive: and her bondwomen were led away mourning as doves, murmuring in their hearts.
text_la: Et miles captivus abductus est, et ancillæ ejus minabantur gementes ut columbæ, murmurantes in cordibus suis.
text_pt: Nínive desde que existiu tem sido como um tanque de águas, porém elas agora vazam. Parai, parai, clamar-se-á; mas ninguém olhará para trás.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ὑπόστασις ἀπεκαλύφθη καὶ αὕτη ἀνέβαινεν καὶ αἱ δοῦλαι αὐτῆς ἤγοντο καθὼς περιστεραὶ φθεγγόμεναι ἐν καρδίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: And as for Ninive, her waters are like a great pool : but the men flee away. They cry: Stand, stand, but there is none that will return back.
text_la: Et Ninive quasi piscina aquarum aquæ ejus; ipsi vero fugerunt. State, state! et non est qui revertatur.
text_pt: Saqueai a prata, saqueai o ouro, porque não têm fim as provi-sões, riquezas há de todo o gênero de bens desejáveis.
text_el: καὶ Νινευη ὡς κολυμβήθρα ὕδατος τὰ ὕδατα αὐτῆς καὶ αὐτοὶ φεύγοντες οὐκ ἔστησαν καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐπιβλέπων

text_en: Take the spoil of the silver, take the spoil of the gold: for there is no end of the riches of all the precious furniture.
text_la: Diripite argentum, diripite aurum : et non est finis divitiarum ex omnibus vasis desiderabilibus.
text_pt: Vazia, esgotada e devastada está; derrete-se o coração, e tremem os joelhos, e em todos os lombos há dor, e os rostos de todos eles se enegrecem.
text_el: διήρπαζον τὸ ἀργύριον διήρπαζον τὸ χρυσίον καὶ οὐκ ἦν πέρας τοῦ κόσμου αὐτῆς βεβάρυνται ὑπὲρ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἐπιθυμητὰ αὐτῆς

text_en: She is destroyed, and rent, and torn: the heart melts, and the knees fail, and all the loins lose their strength: and the faces of them all are as the blackness of a kettle.
text_la: Dissipata est, et scissa, et dilacerata; et cor tabescens, et dissolutio geniculorum, et defectio in cunctis renibus, et facies omnium eorum sicut nigredo ollæ.
text_pt: Onde está agora o covil dos leões, e as pastagens dos leõezinhos, onde passeava o leão velho, e o filhote do leão, sem haver ninguém que os espantasse?
text_el: ἐκτιναγμὸς καὶ ἀνατιναγμὸς καὶ ἐκβρασμὸς καὶ καρδίας θραυσμὸς καὶ ὑπόλυσις γονάτων καὶ ὠδῖνες ἐπὶ πᾶσαν ὀσφύν καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον πάντων ὡς πρόσκαυμα χύτρας

text_en: Where is now the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, to which the lion went, to enter in thither, the young lion, and there was none to make them afraid?
text_la: Ubi est habitaculum leonum, et pascua catulorum leonum, ad quam ivit leo ut ingrederetur illuc catulus leonis, et non est qui exterreat?
text_pt: O leão arrebatava o que bastava para os seus filhotes, e estrangulava a presa para as suas leoas, e enchia de presas as suas cavernas, e os seus covis de rapina.
text_el: ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατοικητήριον τῶν λεόντων καὶ ἡ νομὴ ἡ οὖσα τοῖς σκύμνοις οὗ ἐπορεύθη λέων τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν ἐκεῖ σκύμνος λέοντος καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐκφοβῶν

text_en: The lion caught enough for his whelps, and killed for his lionesses: and he filled his holes with prey, and his den with rapine.
text_la: Leo cepit sufficienter catulis suis, et necavit leænis suis, et implevit præda speluncas suas, et cubile suum rapina.
text_pt: Eis que eu estou contra ti, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos, e queimarei na fumaça os teus carros, e a espada devorará os teus leõezinhos, e arrancarei da terra a tua presa, e não se ouvirá mais a voz dos teus mensageiros.
text_el: λέων ἥρπασεν τὰ ἱκανὰ τοῖς σκύμνοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέπνιξεν τοῖς λέουσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔπλησεν θήρας νοσσιὰν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ κατοικητήριον αὐτοῦ ἁρπαγῆς

text_en: Behold I come against you, says the Lord of hosts , and I will burn your chariots even to smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions: and I will cut off your prey out of the land, and the voice of your messengers shall be heard no more.
text_la: Ecce ego ad te, dicit Dominus exercituum, et succendam usque ad fumum quadrigas tuas, et leunculos tuos comedet gladius, et exterminabo de terra prædam tuam, et non audietur ultra vox nuntiorum tuorum.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σέ λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ καὶ ἐκκαύσω ἐν καπνῷ πλῆθός σου καὶ τοὺς λέοντάς σου καταφάγεται ῥομφαία καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω ἐκ τῆς γῆς τὴν θήραν σου καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ οὐκέτι τὰ ἔργα σου

text_en: Woe to you, O city of blood, all full of lies and violence : rapine shall not depart from you.
text_la: Væ civitas sanguinum, universa mendacii dilaceratione plena! non recedet a te rapina.
text_pt: Ai da cidade ensangüentada! Ela está toda cheia de mentiras e de rapina; não se aparta dela o roubo.
text_el: ὦ πόλις αἱμάτων ὅλη ψευδὴς ἀδικίας πλήρης οὐ ψηλαφηθήσεται θήρα

text_en: The noise of the whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the neighing horse; and of the running chariot, and of the horsemen coming up,
text_la: Vox flagelli, et vox impetus rotæ, et equi frementis, et quadrigæ ferventis, et equitis ascendentis,
text_pt: Estrépito de açoite há, e o barulho do ruído das rodas; e os cavalos atropelam, e carros vão saltando.
text_el: φωνὴ μαστίγων καὶ φωνὴ σεισμοῦ τροχῶν καὶ ἵππου διώκοντος καὶ ἅρματος ἀναβράσσοντος

text_en: and of the shining sword, and of the glittering spear, and of a multitude slain, and of a grievous destruction: and there is no end of carcasses, and they shall fall down on their dead bodies.
text_la: et micantis gladii, et fulgurantis hastæ, et multitudinis interfectæ, et gravis ruinæ; nec est finis cadaverum, et corruent in corporibus suis.
text_pt: O cavaleiro levanta a espada flamejante, como a lança relampejante, e ali haverá uma multidão de mortos, e abundância de cadáveres, e não terão fim os defuntos; tropeçarão nos seus corpos;
text_el: καὶ ἱππέως ἀναβαίνοντος καὶ στιλβούσης ῥομφαίας καὶ ἐξαστραπτόντων ὅπλων καὶ πλήθους τραυματιῶν καὶ βαρείας πτώσεως καὶ οὐκ ἦν πέρας τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῆς καὶ ἀσθενήσουσιν ἐν τοῖς σώμασιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Because of the multitude of the fornications of the harlot that was beautiful and agreeable, and that made use of witchcraft, that sold nations through her fornications, and families through her witchcrafts.
text_la: Propter multitudinem fornicationum meretricis speciosæ, et gratæ, et habentis maleficia, quæ vendidit gentes in fornicationibus suis, et familias in maleficiis suis.
text_pt: Por causa da multidão dos pecados da meretriz mui graciosa, da mestra das feitiçarias, que vendeu as nações com as suas fornicações, e as famílias pelas suas feitiçarias.
text_el: ἀπὸ πλήθους πορνείας πόρνη καλὴ καὶ ἐπιχαρὴς ἡγουμένη φαρμάκων ἡ πωλοῦσα ἔθνη ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ αὐτῆς καὶ φυλὰς ἐν τοῖς φαρμάκοις αὐτῆς

text_en: Behold I come against you, says the Lord of hosts : and I will discover your shame to your face, and will show your nakedness to the nations, and your shame to kingdoms.
text_la: Ecce ego ad te, dicit Dominus exercituum, et revelabo pudenda tua in facie tua; et ostendam gentibus nuditatem tuam, et regnis ignominiam tuam.
text_pt: Eis que eu estou contra ti, diz o Senhor dos Exércitos; e levantarei a tua saia sobre a tua face, e às nações mostrarei a tua nudez, e aos reinos a tua vergonha.
text_el: ἰδοῦ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σέ λέγει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ καὶ ἀποκαλύψω τὰ ὀπίσω σου ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ δείξω ἔθνεσιν τὴν αἰσχύνην σου καὶ βασιλείαις τὴν ἀτιμίαν σου

text_en: And I will cast abominations upon you, and will disgrace you, and will make an example of you.
text_la: Et projiciam super te abominationes, et contumeliis te afficiam, et ponam te in exemplum.
text_pt: E lançarei sobre ti coisas abomináveis, e envergonhar-te-ei, e pôr-te-ei como espetáculo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιρρίψω ἐπὶ σὲ βδελυγμὸν κατὰ τὰς ἀκαθαρσίας σου καὶ θήσομαί σε εἰς παράδειγμα

text_en: And it shall come to pass that every one that shall see you, shall flee from you, and shall say: Ninive is laid waste: who shall bemoan you? Whence shall I seek a comforter for you?
text_la: Et erit : omnis qui viderit te resiliet a te, et dicet : Vastata est Ninive. Quis commovebit super te caput? unde quæram consolatorem tibi?
text_pt: E há de ser que, todos os que te virem, fugirão de ti, e dirão: Nínive está destruída, quem terá compaixão dela? Donde te buscarei consoladores?
text_el: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὁ ὁρῶν σε ἀποπηδήσεται ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἐρεῖ Δειλαία Νινευη τίς στενάξει αὐτήν πόθεν ζητήσω παράκλησιν αὐτῇ

text_en: Are you better than the populous Alexandria, that dwells among the rivers? Waters are round about it: the sea is its riches: the waters are its walls.
text_la: Numquid melior es Alexandria populorum, quæ habitat in fluminibus? aquæ in circuitu ejus; cujus divitiæ, mare; aquæ, muri ejus.
text_pt: És tu melhor do que Nô-Amom, que está assentada entre os canais do Nilo, cercada de águas, tendo por esplanada o mar, e ainda o mar por muralha?
text_el: ἑτοίμασαι μερίδα ἅρμοσαι χορδήν ἑτοίμασαι μερίδα Αμων ἡ κατοικοῦσα ἐν ποταμοῖς ὕδωρ κύκλῳ αὐτῆς ἧς ἡ ἀρχὴ θάλασσα καὶ ὕδωρ τὰ τείχη αὐτῆς

text_en: Ethiopia and Egypt were the strength thereof, and there is no end: Africa and the Libyans were your helpers.
text_la: Æthiopia fortitudo ejus, et Ægyptus, et non est finis; Africa et Libyes fuerunt in auxilio tuo.
text_pt: Etiópia e Egito eram a sua força, e não tinha fim; Pute e Líbia foram o seu socorro.
text_el: καὶ Αἰθιοπία ἡ ἰσχὺς αὐτῆς καὶ Αἴγυπτος καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν πέρας τῆς φυγῆς καὶ Λίβυες ἐγένοντο βοηθοὶ αὐτῆς

text_en: Yet she also was removed and carried into captivity: her young children were dashed in pieces at the top of every street, and they cast lots upon her nobles, and all her great men were bound in fetters.
text_la: Sed et ipsa in transmigrationem ducta est in captivitatem : parvuli ejus elisi sunt in capite omnium viarum, et super inclytos ejus miserunt sortem, et omnes optimates ejus confixi sunt in compedibus.
text_pt: Todavia foi levada cativa para o desterro; também os seus filhos foram despedaçados nas entradas de todas as ruas, e sobre os seus nobres lançaram sortes, e todos os seus grandes foram presos com grilhões.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὴ εἰς μετοικεσίαν πορεύσεται αἰχμάλωτος καὶ τὰ νήπια αὐτῆς ἐδαφιοῦσιν ἐπ' ἀρχὰς πασῶν τῶν ὁδῶν αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔνδοξα αὐτῆς βαλοῦσιν κλήρους καὶ πάντες οἱ μεγιστᾶνες αὐτῆς δεθήσονται χειροπέδαις

text_en: Therefore you also shall be made drunk, and shall be despised : and you shall seek help from your enemies.
text_la: Et tu ergo inebriaberis, et eris despecta : et tu quæres auxilium ab inimico.
text_pt: Tu também serás embriagada, e te esconderás; também buscarás força por causa do inimigo.
text_el: καὶ σὺ μεθυσθήσῃ καὶ ἔσῃ ὑπερεωραμένη καὶ σὺ ζητήσεις σεαυτῇ στάσιν ἐξ ἐχθρῶν

text_en: All your strong holds shall be like fig trees with their green figs: if they be shaken, they shall fall into the mouth of the eater.
text_la: Omnes munitiones tuæ sicut ficus cum grossis suis : si concussæ fuerint, cadent in os comedentis.
text_pt: Todas as tuas fortalezas serão como figueiras com figos temporãos; se os sacodem, caem na boca do que os há de comer.
text_el: πάντα τὰ ὀχυρώματά σου συκαῖ σκοποὺς ἔχουσαι ἐὰν σαλευθῶσιν καὶ πεσοῦνται εἰς στόμα ἔσθοντος

text_en: Behold your people in the midst of you are women : the gates of your land shall be set wide open to your enemies, the fire shall devour your bars.
text_la: Ecce populus tuus mulieres in medio tui : inimicis tuis adapertione pandentur portæ terræ tuæ, devorabit ignis vectes tuos.
text_pt: Eis que o teu povo no meio de ti são como mulheres; as portas da tua terra estarão de todo abertas aos teus inimigos; o fogo consumirá os teus ferrolhos.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ὁ λαός σου ὡς γυναῖκες ἐν σοί τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου ἀνοιγόμεναι ἀνοιχθήσονται πύλαι τῆς γῆς σου καὶ καταφάγεται πῦρ τοὺς μοχλούς σου

text_en: Draw you water for the siege, build up your bulwarks: go into the clay, and tread, work it and make brick.
text_la: Aquam propter obsidionem hauri tibi : exstrue munitiones tuas, intra in lutum, et calca, subigens tene laterem.
text_pt: Tira águas para o cerco, reforça as tuas fortalezas; entra no lodo, e pisa o barro, pega a forma para os tijolos.
text_el: ὕδωρ περιοχῆς ἐπίσπασαι σεαυτῇ καὶ κατακράτησον τῶν ὀχυρωμάτων σου ἔμβηθι εἰς πηλὸν καὶ συμπατήθητι ἐν ἀχύροις κατακράτησον ὑπὲρ πλίνθον

text_en: There shall the fire devour you: you shall perish by the sword, it shall devour you like the bruchus: assemble together like the bruchus, make yourself many like the locust.
text_la: Ibi comedet te ignis, peribis gladio, devorabit te ut bruchus : congregare ut bruchus, multiplicare ut locusta.
text_pt: O fogo ali te consumirá, a espada te exterminará; consumir-te-á, como a locusta. Multiplica-te como a locusta, multiplica-te como os gafanhotos.
text_el: ἐκεῖ καταφάγεταί σε πῦρ ἐξολεθρεύσει σε ῥομφαία καταφάγεταί σε ὡς ἀκρίς καὶ βαρυνθήσῃ ὡς βροῦχος

text_en: You have multiplied your merchandises above the stars of heaven : the bruchus has spread himself and flown away.
text_la: Plures fecisti negotiationes tuas quam stellæ sint cæli; bruchus expansus est, et avolavit.
text_pt: Multiplicaste os teus negociantes mais do que as estrelas do céu; a locusta se espalhará e voará.
text_el: ἐπλήθυνας τὰς ἐμπορίας σου ὑπὲρ τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ βροῦχος ὥρμησεν καὶ ἐξεπετάσθη

text_en: Your guards are like the locusts: and your little ones like the locusts of locusts which swarm on the hedges in the day of cold: the sun arose, and they flew away, and their place was not known where they were.
text_la: Custodes tui quasi locustæ, et parvuli tui quasi locustæ locustarum, quæ considunt in sepibus in die frigoris : sol ortus est, et avolaverunt, et non est cognitus locus earum ubi fuerint.
text_pt: Os teus príncipes são como os gafanhotos, e os teus capitàes como os gafanhotos grandes, que se acampam nas sebes nos dias de frio; em subindo o sol voam, de sorte que não se sabe mais o lugar onde estão.
text_el: ἐξήλατο ὡς ἀττέλεβος ὁ σύμμικτός σου ὡς ἀκρὶς ἐπιβεβηκυῖα ἐπὶ φραγμὸν ἐν ἡμέραις πάγους ὁ ἥλιος ἀνέτειλεν καὶ ἀφήλατο καὶ οὐκ ἔγνω τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς οὐαὶ αὐτοῖς

text_en: Your shepherds have slumbered, O king of Assyria , your princes shall be buried: your people are hid in the mountains, and there is none to gather them.
text_la: Dormitaverunt pastores tui, rex Assur, sepelientur principes tui : latitavit populus tuus in montibus, et non est qui congreget.
text_pt: Os teus pastores dormirão, ó rei da Assíria, os teus ilustres repousarão, o teu povo se espalhará pelos montes, sem que haja quem o ajunte.
text_el: ἐνύσταξαν οἱ ποιμένες σου βασιλεὺς Ἀσσύριος ἐκοίμισεν τοὺς δυνάστας σου ἀπῆρεν ὁ λαός σου ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐκδεχόμενος

text_en: Your destruction is not hidden, your wound is grievous: all that have heard the fame of you, have clapped their hands over you: for upon whom has not your wickedness passed continually?
text_la: Non est obscura contritio tua; pessima est plaga tua. Omnes qui audierunt auditionem tuam compresserunt manum super te : quia super quem non transiit malitia tua semper?
text_pt: Não há cura para a tua ferida, a tua chaga é dolorosa. Todos os que ouvirem a tua fama baterão as palmas sobre ti; porque, sobre quem não passou continuamente a tua malícia?
text_el: οὐκ ἔστιν ἴασις τῇ συντριβῇ σου ἐφλέγμανεν ἡ πληγή σου πάντες οἱ ἀκούοντες τὴν ἀγγελίαν σου κροτήσουσιν χεῖρας ἐπὶ σέ διότι ἐπὶ τίνα οὐκ ἐπῆλθεν ἡ κακία σου διὰ παντός
